en.headline: Sui-Tang civilisation exhibition continues at History Museum
en.dek: More than 165 artefacts from Shaanxi, including 18 national first-class cultural relics, remain on show at the Hong Kong Museum of History until 30 November under the title Chang’an Myriad Vistas.
body: The Hong Kong Museum of History is presenting “Hong Kong Jockey Club Presents Series: Chang’an Myriad Vistas — Civilisation of the Sui and Tang Dynasties from Shaanxi”. The exhibition, jointly organised with the Shaanxi Provincial Cultural Heritage Administration and sponsored by the Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust, features more than 165 sets of artefacts drawn from eleven cultural institutions in Shaanxi as well as finds from Hong Kong.

Among the exhibits are 18 national first-class cultural relics. Highlights include the pure-gold reliquary used to hold Buddhist relics, a painted dancing figure with double-ring hairstyle, and gilt-silver vessels from the Hejiacun hoard. The display is arranged around the ward system of Tang Chang’an and incorporates multimedia presentations of the Six Steeds of Zhao Mausoleum.

Admission is free. The exhibition runs until 30 November. The museum is open daily from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., closed on Tuesdays except public holidays. Visitors can check the museum website for the latest opening arrangements and any guided-tour schedules.

zh.headline: 歷史博物館隋唐文明展繼續展出至11月底
zh.dek: 「長安萬象—陝西隋唐文明展」展出逾165件（套）文物，包括18件國家一級文物，免費入場，展期至11月30日。
body: 香港歷史博物館正展出「香港賽馬會呈獻系列：長安萬象—陝西隋唐文明展」。展覽由康樂及文化事務署與陝西省文物局合辦，香港賽馬會慈善信託基金獨家贊助，展品來自陝西11家文博單位及本港出土文物，共逾165件（套）。
展品包括18件國家一級文物，當中有用以盛裝佛骨的智慧輪盝頂純金寶函、彩繪雙環望仙髻女舞俑，以及何家村窖藏鎏金蓮花形銀器等。展覽以唐長安城里坊制為佈局，並以多媒體呈現昭陵六駿石刻故事。
展覽免費入場，展期至11月30日。博物館開放時間為每日上午10時至下午6時，逢星期二休館（公眾假期除外）。市民可留意博物館網頁最新開放安排及導賞詳情。
